name: Audit Everything Independent Review Profile
description: Comprehensive independent multi-domain audit across 17 engineering perspectives

optional_specialists.trigger: Complex, high-risk, or release-level multi-perspective orchestration
Deep design-system token consistency and drift audit
PostgreSQL indexing, query execution plans, and RLS audit
Web performance, Core Web Vitals, and WCAG accessibility audit
Public route SEO, JSON-LD schema, and AI search visibility audit

routing_flow: 1. Requirements & Architecture Audit: Verify boundary integrity and adherence to ADRs
2. Code Quality & Correctness: Run Addy Osmani code review & quality auditor
3. UI/UX & Polish Audit: Run Impeccable critic for spacing, typography, and anti-slop
4. Security & Privacy Audit: Run Trail of Bits static & variant analysis + OWASP checks
5. Database & Backend Audit: Check query plans, transactions, idempotency, and retries
6. Accessibility & Performance Audit: Run WCAG checks, CWV profiling, and memory audits
7. Supply-Chain & Release Gate: Validate dependency pins, licenses, and release checklists
release_gate: Did we solve the requested problem?
Does it respect the framework/platform conventions?
Is the UI intentionally designed with good hierarchy?
Is the backend/data behavior correct (transactions, idempotency)?
Is security appropriate to the risk level?
Is SEO/GEO correct for public web content?
Does it work at runtime without errors?
Did an independent review challenge the implementation?
Is there concrete evidence for the final verification claim?
